scope: Six fresh processes: four ordinary native/bulk memory runs (two capacities,50 teacher steps) and two legacy paired resource runs (two capacities,12 steps). Unchanged policies,host allocator,prefill lifetimes; no exact-root/cleanup/VMM candidate.
primary: Determine current allocated/reserved-plus-live-host resource envelopes against512MiB; exact control/bulk state/IDs/counters/payload. No speed or superiority claim.
observers: Public CUDA pinned range,public Torch allocator snapshots,unique constant model storage,weak prefill-logits lifetime. No GPU payload/model owners retained by observer; timings invalid.
limits: Other host allocations/cache,CUDA-driver/non-Torch scopes excluded. A failed lower bound contradicts completion; a passing observed envelope alone cannot prove complete resource equality.
next: Only choose next mechanism after authoritative envelope/allocation/lifetime evidence; preserve512MiB target and frozen inspected quality holdouts.
